query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid), COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId), COUNT(DISTINCT name), COUNT(DISTINCT setCode) FROM cards;
result: 56822 rows; 56822 distinct uuid; 21769 distinct scryfallOracleId; 21738 distinct name; 536 distinct setCode
validation_method: direct aggregate query on the target database

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT name FROM cards GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(scryfallOracleId,''))>1); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE scryfallOracleId IS NULL OR name IS NULL);
result: 7 names map to more than one scryfallOracleId; scryfallOracleId and name are never null

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT code) FROM sets; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT setCode FROM cards EXCEPT SELECT code FROM sets); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT code FROM sets EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT setCode FROM cards);

query: SELECT colors, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY colors ORDER BY 2 DESC; SELECT SUM(colorIdentity IS NULL), COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE colorIdentity LIKE '%,%'; SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT colorIdentity) FROM cards;

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE colors IS NOT NULL AND colors GLOB '*[^WUBRG,]*'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE colorIdentity IS NOT NULL AND colorIdentity GLOB '*[^WUBRG,]*';
result: 0 rows in both columns contain any character outside W, U, B, R, G and the comma; no colorless letter C exists
validation_method: character-class scan over all non-null values

query: SELECT MIN(convertedManaCost), MAX(convertedManaCost), SUM(convertedManaCost IS NULL), SUM(faceConvertedManaCost IS NULL), SUM(manaCost IS NULL) FROM cards; SELECT name, setCode, convertedManaCost, layout FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY layout;
result: convertedManaCost range 0.0 to 1000000.0; never null; manaCost null for 7323 rows; faceConvertedManaCost null for 55867 rows and non-null only for layouts transform, split, aftermath and adventure; outlier Gleemax in set UNH with cost 1000000

query: SELECT DISTINCT power FROM cards ORDER BY power LIMIT 30; SELECT types, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power IS NOT NULL GROUP BY types ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10; SELECT SUM(loyalty IS NOT NULL), SUM(hand IS NOT NULL), SUM(life IS NOT NULL) FROM cards;

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE types LIKE '%, %'; SELECT subtypes, COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE subtypes LIKE '%,%' GROUP BY subtypes ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE type LIKE '%—%'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE types LIKE 'Summon%';
result: 0 rows have a comma followed by a space in types; subtypes combine as Human,Wizard and Human,Soldier; 34594 rows contain an em dash in the type line and 0 rows use a plain hyphen separator; 13 rows use Summon in types instead of Creature
validation_method: pattern-scan queries on the target database

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE types LIKE '%Scariest%';
result: 1 row whose types value contains commas inside a single type name, so a naive comma split mis-parses that card's types

query: SELECT format, status, COUNT(*) FROM legalities GROUP BY format, status ORDER BY format, 3 DESC;
result: 15 lowercase formats; exactly three capitalized statuses. For example vintage Legal 55059, Restricted 413, Banned 104; legacy Banned 546; modern Banned 199; commander Banned 332; pauper has 22784 rows and standard 7698

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) FROM legalities; SELECT n, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) n FROM legalities GROUP BY uuid) GROUP BY n ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10;
result: 427907 rows over 55608 distinct uuid values, compared with 56822 printings in cards; no status value Not Legal exists; printings carry rows for between 4 and 14 of the 15 formats

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT text), COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) FROM rulings; SELECT MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM rulings; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT text FROM rulings GROUP BY text HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid)>1);
